items.note: K.1 states the three-stage signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and K.1.1-K.1.3 follow the proof (net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c; cancellation; three stages). But the ground set h=100, the neighbour rule and the eight-row schedule are not stated, and the cancellation is checked only in the bit case: the complex coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 (756-758) is missing.

It states and proves the invariant (stored = D_v·logical, linearity at a common-frame gate), the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, all as in 804-825.

All the defining content is stated: nondegenerate labels in the m-dimensional F^{⊗3} from triple indicators, orthogonal for neighbours; comparable labels; only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each losing h; L=Ich; Wm-2N+2L; ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation is thin: K.3.1.2 restates the lemma. The bilinear forms (856-868), the stage transitions, the gate-label table (975-988) and the residual table (1021-1060) are only gestured at, and the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument is absent.

Projection matrices on nested labels (K.3 method), rank = dimension change (K.3.2), the N negative source exceptions giving s=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L (K.3.3), the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (K.3.4), and the shear H<-H+D on every role (K.7) all follow 1156-1172 and 1504-1533. The frame Φ_M is named only as an 'address shear', not defined.

Phase frames H^{⊗m} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{⊗m}, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m are stated. The proof (weight additivity mod 4, Hadamard taking the character to a translation, the Z/i^{27k} endpoint corrections at 1287-1314) is not reconstructed. S3.1.1 claims C^{⊗m} on every role by telescoping but drops the required diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange.

L<N/2, s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, deficit >20·2^{-50} and tau=1-2^{-50} are present. The explicit deficits eta_b, eta_c are not given. The fact log m<20 (1332), which turns eta>20·2^{-50} into m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), is omitted, so K.3.5's inference is incomplete.

S1.1 states the elementary operations correctly. S1.2's claim gives O(V) for a controlled shift without the condition that the offset be prepared in b^{O(1)} time and without the prime/coprime-denominator hypotheses (that condition appears only inside the quote). The method 'splitting blocks and re-merging' is a single phrase and not a derivation.

It gives the elimination by topmost row and rightmost pivot with lower-triangular operations, the a ones of Pi, the conjugation by E_1, E_2 at O(V), and the three-update realisation of H_i<-H_i+D_j with one interchange, exactly as at 1375-1446.

It covers the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} edges via recursive interchanges, Φ_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D, on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the parking-stack schedule, all following 1491-1588.

Rows from rho=O(log e) high digits padded to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces handled by the power-width procedure, the geometric cost sum, and padding binary ranges to [q^e] follow 1649-1734. The unequal-width extension (1740-1762) is omitted, but it is not part of the lemma.

It states the s_c child calls on f=e/m axes of one slot and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The conjugation by P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots (1849-1865, 1878-1882), the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C^{⊗f} Z (1885-1888) and the reduction of M to a fixed number of row additions (1892-1901) are missing as steps. S3's method only alludes to binary basis changes.

It gives the eight conditional additions that flip parity and restore w, the bad-set bound 80(f-1)2^{-K}, rotations as swap + controlled cyclic shift + unswap, sort-and-reinsert repair implementing T_0, and the extra terms becoming o(1), following 2013-2210.

It states the s calls with node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the child volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e) for e<d^beta, and the final range of lambda'. Missing: the row source q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0} (2306-2323), and the unrolling itself, i.e. K<=e^{c/beta}, the internal sum O(e^lambda) and the leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)} (2413-2430).

It states O(Vd^{lambda'}) with exactness up to one truncation and error <sqrt2·2^{-p} (S3.6). The guard-width argument (A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, depth-to-size induction, p+Delta and Delta+3 bits, Delta=o(p)) and the proof's assembly follow the paper.

It gives omega_t=y^{2r/t}, contractions, character cancellation, DIF with signed-shift twiddles, bit-reversed storage giving B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the layout costs (prefix moves, Dq-1 chunk exchanges, simultaneous rounds) and error sqrt2·l·2^{-p}, matching the paper.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four integer products with the established multiplier, the separation bound |h_j|<B_0/2, centred-residue recovery with 0/1 carries and negacyclic reduction all match 3233-3335.

Two forward transforms kept in common LB order (S4's motivation gives the commutation of pointwise product with a common permutation), the pointwise signed-packed products, the opposite transform, exact scaling by M, the error sqrt2·M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the added O(Tp log(rp)) cost all match the paper.

It covers the identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA via the HvdH identity, Neumann inversion of N, A=S', B_0=D'J'C with normalisations 2^{-2alpha^2}, tensoring with gamma=2d·alpha^2, and the line costs and axis-exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.

It verifies the chirp identity coefficientwise, gets RF_s^+R=F_s^+ from t_i being a unit mod s_i, and derives (u*v)/S^2 from the two normalisations, following 3938-3988. The clause on conjugating to obtain RF_s^+ is not stated.

The exponents, sizes, prime intervals, T/2<S<T, alpha^4·theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search are given and derived as in the paper. But eta=1/(4d), alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) and gamma=2d·alpha^2 with gamma<=b/4 (4089-4101) are never defined, although eta is used.

It gives the isomorphism argument, the triangular digit formula, the update order i=d..1, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, axis reversal by chunk exchanges and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)), matching 4216-4296.

It checks that the twist is well defined, diagonal and an isomorphism, and that zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, then gives the computed twist/convolve/untwist (S6.5), as in the paper. Twist error bounds are not mentioned.

It gives the chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, the six steps (Phi, two transforms, product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries), and the exact-counterpart justification (S6.9). Missing: the digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, and the definition of the opposite transform by conjugation, F~^+(z)=conj(F~(conj z)) (4478-4484).

E_s=9·2^gamma·TL, E_w<28·2^gamma·T^2L, the final bound <1/2, exact rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output are all stated correctly. The chain that produces E_s (ring error <5TL, chirp <8TL, the disk-margin checks at 4569-4656) is not reconstructed: S6.10.1 just asserts E_s.
The cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2·kappa, the row justifications, the o(V) exceptional sorting, absorption of log p powers and the schoolbook cutoff match 4815-4995.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture in this model, but the eventual-lower-bound quantifiers and the liminf argument of 381-387 are absent.

errors.says: Method: add up dimension changes over the network 'plus one extra rank per source'.
errors.paper: Only the N sources X_a carry the matrix -P_{U_a}; every other source has matrix zero, so only those N first edges (matrix 2P_{U_a}, rank one, zero dimension change) add rank (1117-1118, 1162-1165).

errors.says: The relative deficit exceeds 20·2^{-50}, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta) and hence s/W<m^tau.
errors.paper: The inference also needs log m<20 (from m<2^{20}), which gives m^{1-2^{-50}}=m·exp(-2^{-50}·log m)>m(1-20·2^{-50}) (1331-1338); the step omits it.

errors.says: Telescoping the phase frames gives C^{⊗m} on every role, scratch roles included.
errors.paper: This holds only after source and sink diagonal corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange (1225-1227). Without them the X_a->Y_a route gets C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) (1297-1314).

errors.says: Motivation: the residual dimension counts the kernels per edge, 'matching the rank count of the bit network'.
errors.paper: The complex count is s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c on a different network (1222), whereas s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b includes N extra source ranks (1151, 1162-1165). The counts are analogous, not equal.

errors.says: Adding an offset computed from earlier control fields to a later field, or multiplying it by a rational unit, costs O(V).
errors.paper: The lemma requires the offset to be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, a prime q and denominators (and, for units, numerators) prime to q (555-568). The claim states the cost unconditionally, though the quote carries the condition.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. The exchange network, frames, labels, rank budget and endpoint identity (K.1-K.3) feed the power-width interchange recurrence (K.4-K.9), then chunk interchange (S2), the simultaneous butterfly layer (S3), synthetic transforms and convolution (S4), resampling and chirp (S5), and the multiplication reduction with exact recovery (S6), ending in the cost table with min margin 2·kappa (S7). It thins out at the label construction (the table of labels and residuals is asserted rather than shown), the complex phase interface (its proof and endpoint corrections are skipped), the P_M conjugation in the phase-frame recursion, the unrolling of the layer recurrence, and the error chain before E_s. The step from eta>20·2^{-50} to s/W<m^tau also omits log m<20.

steps.note: The fixed network of three-element-subset wires, run in three stages with (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and every scratch wire restored, is stated and derived. The sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given (m appears only as the dimension of F^{⊗3}), so this is a thin reconstruction.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, the operator is D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and intermediate frames are free so each edge pays only a change of frame.
Nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h, are all stated.

P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U (K.3.2), and the N negative source projections are the exceptions (K.3.3). That each exception has rank one is implicit in s=Wm-N+2L and in K.3's 'one extra rank per source' (loosely worded).
Sum of |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (K.3.1.3), and s=Wm-N+2L (K.3.3).
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L>0 and s<Wm.
P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, other roles 0 and I_m, so the network applies Φ_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D, on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, triangular parts at O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, so exactly a interchanges per edge and s recursive calls per node.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present. The supporting fact log m<20 is omitted, which leaves the exponent step slightly incomplete.

central.summary: P01 reconstructs the whole central chain in order: exchange network, frames, labels, rank = dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence to O(e^tau). The weak points are that the sizes h=100, N and m are never given, the label construction is asserted rather than shown, and the log m<20 step behind tau=1-2^{-50} is omitted.
